title: MPP subscription: activation and one renewal per period
summary: The client grants a recurring authorization once. The server collects the first period on activation and returns a subscriptionId, then collects at most one renewal per later period, before or with delivery. Any failure returns 402 with a fresh challenge.
specVersion: draft-payment-intent-subscription-00 with draft-tempo-subscription-00 (added 2026-07-29, repository text of 2026-08-07, unchanged at commit 50309c8)

steps.label: 402 with intent="subscription"
steps.detail: request carries amount, currency, periodUnit and periodCount; Tempo also needs recipient and subscriptionExpires and allows only day or week.

steps.label: Credential with the grant
steps.detail: On Tempo the payload is a keyAuthorization signature for an access key with limits; on Stripe it is a PaymentMethod and customer.

steps.label: Collect the first period
steps.detail: The server verifies the grant, collects the first charge and stores durable subscription state.

steps.label: 200 with subscriptionId in the receipt
steps.detail: The subscription is active only after these steps succeed. The id alone authorizes nothing later.

steps.label: Next period: one renewal
steps.detail: For each later period the server may collect one renewal, before or atomically with delivery. Missed periods do not add up.

failures.outcome: 402 with a fresh challenge; no further renewals.

steps.label: Serve the period
steps.detail: Access for the period follows the collected renewal.
